baselineReason: Phase 12 recorded Home at 94982 bytes; the shipped Phase 13/14 surfaces pushed it to ~99500. The previous version of this file recorded Detail as 90180 from the build's page->chunk manifest, and that walk omitted the entry chunk (D9LRRIIJ.js, 10251 gzip bytes). The first real HTTP capture of Detail measured 100464 over 6 scripts, so the ceiling had never actually been enforced on a correct Detail number.
measurementMethod: Production build (nuxt build) -> SSR document of each route -> every script response the browser actually fetches, gzip level 9. These totals are CI's HTTP capture, not a manifest walk: run 43063871980, commit 450608c, Chromium through the real Nuxt server. Chunk filenames below are from the same commit's build and are build-specific; only the totals are contractual and CI re-measures them on every push.

category.note: Not measured: the HTTP capture covers Home and Detail only. The former 99087 figure came from the manifest walk that omitted the entry chunk, so it is not comparable with a real capture and is not recorded as if it were.

detail.note: Real HTTP capture. The 79663-byte vendor/shell chunk and the 10251-byte entry dominate; the Detail route chunk itself is 9487. This is why the ceiling moved to 104000 rather than the page being trimmed by an invented amount.
